review_description: Would recommend this firm to anyone--easy and pleasant to deal with and rapid response to all matters.

Several other companies never bothered to follow up with us after their initial consultation.So the only option was to go with those who did provide follow up with good communication which gave us confidence in them.Thankyou Finn for guiding us through this complicated process with your much appreciated knowledge.Regards Wayne.
The organisation was very professional with paperwork and communication. I was also very impressed with the quality and expertise of the installers

Kylie from Solar energy environment was awesome to deal with. When they couldn't deliver a product they said they could (tilt frames for tile roof) we were offered a discount. They offer after sales service that they will make sure we will get the best value.
